The floor is computed through ONE function (key_row_floor) shared by the fill loop and the falsifier -- no second copy, per 1.0.0_SA_CTO~X's constraint -- and it implements MIN over sub-claims PRESENT with a valued-but-undeclared sub-claim entering at inferred, NOT a declared-only MIN. mutant.description: The floor falsifier 4.0.0_SA_CRO~X required before this tool may run, plus the v3 contradiction fixture. ARM 1 (incomplete map -- a valued sub-claim with NO basis entry): confirmed floor reads inferred, rejected declared-only reads measured -- the arms DISAGREE and are reachable from different truths. ARM 2 (complete map): both read measured -- the control that stops a falsifier passing by always disagreeing. Two further arms: a MIN arm (one weak sub-claim sinks an otherwise-measured row) and a null-expression cap arm. The tool REFUSES to run if any arm fails, so it cannot degrade into a declared-but-unrun promise. CONTRADICTION FIXTURE: basis measured with a null key_expression is REFUSED by v3, exercised inside the tool and again outside it.

MIN arm and null-expression cap arm both hold. Contradiction fixture REFUSED inside the tool and again by a separate invocation: "'measured' was expected".
